description: This is a Python source file implementing a tool for loading and interacting with firmware on Intel cAVS (Core Audio Voice Stream) hardware, specifically for Intel ADSP (Audio Digital Signal Processor) systems. It includes classes and functions for memory mapping, hardware register access, firmware loading, and IPC command handling, with a focus on managing HD-Audio streams and DSP boot procedures.

classes.name: Regs
classes.description: A helper class for defining and accessing hardware register blocks via memory-mapped I/O. It allows defining register offsets as attributes and provides methods to freeze the layout and access register values directly.

classes.name: HDAStream
classes.description: Represents an HD-Audio stream, providing methods to configure, start, stop, reset, and debug the stream. It manages buffers in huge pages and interacts with hardware registers for stream control.

methods.name: map_phys_mem
methods.description: Maps 2MB of hugepage memory, retrieves its physical address via /proc/self/pagemap, and returns the memory object and physical address for DMA use.

methods.name: bar_map
methods.description: Maps a PCI BAR resource into process address space and returns the mapped address.

methods.name: runx
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its output as a string.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Returns a bitmask for a given bit position, depending on hardware version.

methods.name: load_firmware
methods.description: Loads firmware binary into device memory, resets hardware, configures streams, and initiates firmware boot sequence.

methods.name: fw_is_alive
methods.description: Checks if the firmware has signaled it is fully booted and operational.

methods.name: wait_fw_entered
methods.description: Waits for firmware to signal it has entered the main operational state, with optional timeout.

methods.name: ipc_command
methods.description: Sends IPC commands to the DSP, including reset, configuration, start/stop, and log retrieval commands.

methods.name: win_read
methods.description: Reads a block of data from the winstream memory region.

methods.name: win_hdr
methods.description: Unpacks the header of the winstream data, returning length, start, end, and sequence number.
